exposure: temporal avascular area of the retina
outcome: need for retinopathy of prematurity treatment
cohort: 276 preterm infants included in a retinopathy of prematurity screening programme
finding: Greater duration of mechanical ventilation, a broader avascular area of the temporal retina at the first binocular screening, and slow retinal vascularisation strongly predict the need for retinopathy of prematurity treatment.
